header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Omparkash H. Karmani advocate for the applicant.
Mr. Nabi Bux Narejo advocate for the respondents.
Mr. Neel Parkash Deputy Prosecutor General Sindh.
body: After arguing the matter at some length, learned counsel for the applicant does not press the instant Criminal Misc. Application to file direct complaint before Court having jurisdiction.
In view of the above, the instant Criminal Misc. Application is disposed of leaving the applicant at liberty to file a complaint in accordance with law. JUDGE *Chander Kumar*
